card.text: Explore Ilioneus in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Jupiter Trojan in the L5 trailing cloud. Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Ilioneus · DAMIT 4172 convex shape
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 60.711 km effective diameter (fit ±0.982 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation; grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: Ilioneus · source-model radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 30.3555 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
